answer: Problem: cheap clone identities flood agent markets. Mechanism: require each new agent to post a bonded "sparrow" work receipt—timed micro-tasks whose outputs must hash-commit to a prior peer attestation before payout unlocks. Cost: forging N clones needs N real compute-hours and locked stake, not just keys. Verification: peers sample the receipt chain along a "pearl" of linked hashes and reject any break on the trust ridge. Failure handling: if attestation density falls below K or a receipt mismatches, slash the bond and quarantine the lineage for one epoch.
